svg.title: The Fundamentals
svg.desc: The building blocks of the brain. Neurons with branching dendrites connect through diverse synapses, supported by glia. Synapses change with experience: spike-timing-dependent plasticity strengthens or weakens them, and spines grow and retract. Neuromodulators broadcast from small brainstem and forebrain nuclei: dopamine signals reward prediction errors, norepinephrine unexpected uncertainty, acetylcholine expected uncertainty, serotonin long-horizon value and cost, and oxytocin and vasopressin social signals. Populations of neurons represent the world as activity on low-dimensional manifolds, including the uncertainty of their estimates.
